newsitem.title: FRANCE: French woman confesses to killing daughter.
newsitem.headline: French woman confesses to killing daughter.

text.p: A French woman confessed to killing her three-year-old daughter after seeking to blame a sadistic paedophile for the crime, police said on Sunday.

A magistrate ordered Francoise Moreno, 24, to be held in detention and placed her under formal investigation for murder aggravated by rape. Moreno's own father said she deserved to spend the rest of her life in jail.

Moreno, who had won wide sympathy among French people distressed by the sexual abuse and killings of children in neighbouring Belgium, confessed to police on Saturday that she killed her daughter Rose-Marie in a fit of rage, police said.
But she denied being responsible of any sexual abuse of the child. Before her confession, Moreno had wept inconsolably at her daughter's funeral on Thursday escorted by dozens of well-wishers.
The child's body was found last Monday in bushes 300 metres (yards) from her home in the southern city of Montpellier.

An autopsy showed the child had been strangled and sexually abused after death, leading police to consider the possibility that a woman had killed her and sought to disguise the crime as a male paedophile attack.
Neighbours said the mother's lover, who shared her flat with Rose-Marie, had often complained of the presence of the child. Police said he was not suspected of involvement.
"I'm very shocked," Moreno's father Jean-Antoine Moreno told Sud radio. "My daughter deserves to spend the rest of her life in jail."
